author: Pierre-MarieMarchio
name: .NET Clean Architecture Presentation Project
description: A presentation project beside the API of a project generated by cleanarch-webapi without one: <project>.<name> in Src/Presentation, its tests, its image and its page, created by its framework's own template when presentation-scaffold runs. Run it at the project root.

choices.description: A Blazor Web App with server interactivity, created by dotnet new blazor when presentation-scaffold runs, calling the use cases in process.

projectName.description: The project's name, as -n gave it to cleanarch-webapi and as its solution file is named (for example Acme.Shop): the presentation project is <project>.<name>.

choices.description: Not an option to set: it names the refusal.

presentationNameIsTaken.isRequired: (name == "Api" || name == "Api.IntegrationTests" || name == "Api.UnitTests" || name == "Application" || name == "Application.Auth" || name == "Application.Auth.UnitTests" || name == "Application.Core" || name == "Application.Core.UnitTests" || name == "Application.UnitTests" || name == "Architecture.Tests" || name == "Domain" || name == "Domain.Core" || name == "Domain.Core.UnitTests" || name == "Domain.UnitTests" || name == "EndToEnd.Tests" || name == "Infrastructure.Auth" || name == "Infrastructure.Auth.IntegrationTests" || name == "Infrastructure.Auth.UnitTests" || name == "Infrastructure.Core" || name == "Infrastructure.Core.UnitTests" || name == "Infrastructure.Email" || name == "Infrastructure.Email.UnitTests" || name == "Infrastructure.InMemory" || name == "Infrastructure.InMemory.UnitTests" || name == "Infrastructure.Persistence" || name == "Infrastructure.Persistence.UnitTests" || name == "Infrastructure.Storage" || name == "Infrastructure.Storage.UnitTests" || name == "Presentation.Core" || name == "Presentation.Core.UnitTests")
presentationNameIsTaken.description: Never set. -n names a project the template already writes, which would be overwritten: choose another name, such as Portal.

agentFiles.description: The project's --agent-files value: the lines to add name AGENTS.md only where the project has it.

developmentConnectionString.description: The Default connection string of appsettings.Development.json, for the chosen database and the credentials .env.example gives it.

postActions.description: Join the presentation project to the project.

manualInstructions.text: Src/Presentation/<project>.<name>/README.md, under 'Joining a project generated without one', gives the lines --presentation writes outside the project's own folders: in .dockerignore, .env.example, Directory.Packages.props (with --auth external), docker-compose.yml, AGENTS.md, two architecture tests and the pages under docs, each with the lines it goes beside. Then run dotnet run Tools/Tasks.cs presentation-scaffold <project>.<name> at the project root, which creates its pages with dotnet new blazor and adds it to the solution, and commit the project.
